rationale: P identifies the braking behavior that must be characterised to evaluate whether the system prevents unintended braking, as required by SG-3 and described in hazard H-3. Its declared operational scope matches H-3. Braking behavior is itself the subject of evaluation here, rather than an ancillary control mechanism. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: “The vehicle's braking behavior” identifies the system behavior directly required by the evaluation target.
“Whether braking occurs as intended or unintentionally” focuses P on the property relevant to preventing unintended braking.
The scope specifies straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and in good weather, matching H-3's operational situation.
